name: Console

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: Owns bounded typed nodes and text bytes; it is not an Int or a live-window handle.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: value.console(); Console options retain role/type constraints.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: Console publications are explicit retained-document effects. Receiver values keep their typed payload and publication order; the Console identity is not an arbitrary resource constructor or a capability grant.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.

summary: A retained output document and its typed publication receiver.
